bodyText:
Event
We watched the Meta Connect 2026 opening keynote. The core updates were: 1) Muse added real-time voice, Mac computer operation, and retail and payment connections, and will be connected to AI glasses in the coming months; 2) It released Ray-Ban Meta Audio, the third-generation Ray-Ban Meta, and upgraded Display's navigation and app discovery, with glasses styles expected to exceed 100 by the end of the year; 3) The strategic position of VR glasses was elevated, with plans to launch Meta VR Glasses weighing only 100g in spring 2027. This launch combines a personal AI Agent with a wearable entry point, and the subsequent focus is to verify Agent task completion, sustained wearing, and return on investment.

Muse: Meta is advancing the personal AI Agent from single Q&A to continuous, cross-application task execution.
Muse was launched in the U.S. in early Sept., runs on a user-exclusive Secure VM, can call browsers and authorized applications, and perform tasks such as sending emails and making reservations; sensitive operations still require user confirmation. At this Connect conference, Meta demonstrated its real-time voice that can work while conversing, the already usable Mac computer operation, and announced newly added retailer and payment connections, its own email, and the pocket device Muse Charm. The core change is connecting task-executable agent capabilities to a carry-on entry point, rather than a single hardware upgrade. Muse has not yet launched on the glasses side, and Meta expects to launch it in the coming months, enabling the agent to take action based on the products or scenes the wearer sees.

Expanding connected applications increases task coverage, but authorization rates and success rates will determine whether Muse can retain users. Meta announced the expansion of retailer connections such as Walmart, Best Buy, and Sephora, and payment connections such as Shop Pay and PayPal, and included services such as Expedia, Instacart, Notion, and GitHub in its roadmap; Muse can already use personal clues such as Instagram saved content to generate suggestions. We believe that social content can help identify demand, and third-party services handle inventory and fulfillment, forming a "discovery-decision-execution" chain; but each step depends on user authorization, interface availability, and task accuracy rate. Meta also stated that Muse's conversation and virtual machine data will not be directly shared with its advertising system, and AI Agent usage cannot simply be equated with advertising revenue.

Muse's charging method has not yet been quantified, and the short-term profit foundation remains the existing advertising business. Meta said Muse can meet most needs for free, and more usage can be obtained through subscription, but did not disclose subscription price, paid conversion, task volume, or per-execution cost. If shopping and booking form a transaction closed loop, service charging opportunities may arise in the future; the related revenue-sharing mechanism and revenue contribution have not yet been announced. In 2Q26, Meta advertising revenue was USD59.36bn, accounting for about 97.6% of total revenue. At this stage, Muse's commercial value should be treated as an increment pending verification, and should not be directly included in certain profit.

AI glasses: Meta forms a product matrix with audio, shooting, display, and VR, with differentiation in wearing experience and usage frequency.
Meta released its first camera-free glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio, and the third-generation Ray-Ban Meta. Ray-Ban Meta Audio is open-ear audio glasses without a camera or display, weighing 43g, with up to 12 hours of battery life, starting at USD349, shipping on Oct. 13; the third-generation Ray-Ban Meta is equipped with a 12mn pixel camera, up to 3K video, and up to 9 hours of battery life, starting at USD449, and is already on sale. Meta also launched a lower-priced Adventurer style and expanded frame options with EssilorLuxottica. We believe that the audio version lowers the visual privacy threshold, and the shooting version continues existing demand, but actual repurchase and all-day wearing rates still need post-sales data verification.

Display is moving from a hardware function to an application entry point, but the developer ecosystem is still at an early stage. The Meta Ray-Ban Display released at last year's Connect was extremely out of stock over the past year and sold out most of the time. This time the hardware was not updated, and the increment is that capacity has finally caught up with demand, it will be sold online at meta.com and rolled out internationally for the first time, and it was confirmed that holographic calling capability will be brought to Display. In the coming weeks, glasses-side AI will upgrade from single Q&A to being able to wake Muse, carry full context, and complete tasks for users in the background.
